Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it “Saint Innocent of Alaska (1797-1879)” and files it under “Innocent of Alaska”. Those are the dates of Innocent (Veniaminov), apostle of Siberia and Alaska and Metropolitan of Moscow — this folder's saint, whose Russian heading is «Иннокентий, митрополит Московский и Коломенский, просветитель Сибири и Америки». A portrait photograph of the saint himself, from the Library of Congress. Commons describes it: Saint Innocent of Alaska (1797-1879)
